lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  refine inner_self_eq_zero'.mp
    (le_antisymm ?_ real_inner_self_nonneg')
  by_contra! hp
  have := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hsub, hsupp, hsmooth, hbounds, hvalue⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
      (this.continuousAt.eventually (lt_mem_nhds hp))
  have :=
    (hsmooth.continuous.mul this).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ)
      hsupp.mul_right (fun x => if hx : φ x = 0 then (mul_eq_zero_of_left hx _).ge
        else mul_nonneg (hbounds (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (le_of_lt (hsub (subset_closure hx))))
      (mul_ne_zero (hvalue.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hp.ne')
  apply this.ne'
  simp only [Pi.mul_apply, ← inner_smul_right']
  apply hg
  exact IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hsmooth, hsupp⟩ contDiff_const

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ := (Set.Finite.pi' fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.finite_Icc B T).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (by intro n k; exact hB (n + k))
  have h m : u (j + m) = u (i + m) := m.strong_induction_on fun m ih =>
    if hm : 4 ≤ m then by
      rify
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
    else congrFun heq.symm ⟨m, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hm⟩
  use i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij
  intro n hn
  convert h (n - i) using 2 <;> omega

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have h3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space (c := 𝓕.c) (n := 2) (i := j) h3 t
  have hEd j k := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB j := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A h3 (j, i)
  have hc j := by
    have e := Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j)
      (hB j) t x
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out)] at e
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)] at e
    exact e
  have hd := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hd
  simp only [div_eq_inv_mul,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x),
    fderiv_const_mul (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      hJd t x),
    _root_.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hd
  have hs := HasFDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) fun j _ =>
    (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (hB j) x t).hasFDerivAt
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, ((hs.const_mul _).fun_sub ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
      (c := 𝓕.c) hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, _root_.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq, hc,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hd, FreeSpace.c_sq, one_div, mul_inv, mul_sub, div_eq_mul_inv,
    mul_assoc, mul_left_comm (𝓕.μ₀⁻¹), one_mul, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.val - a i * 10 ^ i.val + digits_to_num a := by
    refine (congrArg (7 ∣ ·) ?_).mp (((hrelation a b).mp h).2 i)
    rw [← sub_eq_iff_eq_add, hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self,

  have hd := step d e h.1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have h_fiber_diff : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y, Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :=
    generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [fiberMap, iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at hq
  have heval (k : Fin 2) := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (fiberMap k).val)
    (evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs)
  simp only [fiberMap, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←hq] at heval
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i, P_i, heval]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
      rw [h_fiber_diff]
      ring1
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [P_i_plus_1, P₀, P₁, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
        intermediateEvaluationPoly, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
        Polynomial.eval_C, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
      rfl

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let m := mulLinearMap (𝓕 := 𝓕)
  suffices h : (m.comp (m.flip c)).compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp timeOrderF) =
      m.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap.comp ((m c).comp timeOrderF)) from
    congrArg (fun f => f a b) h
  refine ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs' => ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs => ?_
  dsimp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    m, mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, c]
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, hs⟩ : ∃ l1 l2, ∀ (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp),
      (∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 :=
    ⟨_ ++ _, _ ++ _, fun l hl => by
      simpa only [crAnTimeOrderList, List.append_assoc] using
        insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl⟩
  calc
    _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι c *
          ι (ofCrAnListF l2)) := by
      simp only [c, ↓superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        List.singleton_append, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      rw [hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ]), hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])]
      simp only [↓ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub]
      rw [smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      have he := hs [] (by simp)
      simp only [List.append_nil, List.nil_append] at he
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
        (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc,
        ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← he, map_mul]
      by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ
      · simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
          hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
